fare_evidence.fare_local: R$19.00 weekday / R$28.50 weekend-holiday (pedestrians and cyclists free)
fare_evidence.basis: Official crossing tariff; USD at weekday car rate, BCB PTAX 5.0727 (2026-07-15). Weekend car = US$5.62.

fare_evidence.corridor: São Sebastião → Ilhabela (Hora Marcada — official premium timed-boarding slot, car)
fare_evidence.basis: Official DH 'Hora Marcada' queue-skip product — drivers pay ~3.4x the standard fare for a guaranteed boarding time; the state's own evidence that channel users pay a premium for time certainty. Weekend = US$19.32.

fare_evidence.corridor: Ilhabela island piers (Aquabus municipal water bus)
fare_evidence.fare_local: R$4.80 resident card / R$20.00 single ticket (was R$50 tourist tariff in Jan 2025 decree)
fare_evidence.basis: Official municipal tariff page (single ticket); resident card = US$0.95.

fare_evidence.corridor: Vila/Perequê → Praia de Castelhanos (speedboat tour, per person)
fare_evidence.fare_local: R$290.00 (Maremar super boat) / R$310.00 (Bem Passeios flex boat, 6 pax)
fare_evidence.basis: Live operator pricing for the boat-only flagship beach — the premium water-mobility comparable on the island. Bem Passeios = US$61.11.

fare_evidence.corridor: Ilhabela vehicle entry (TPA environmental fee, from 31 Mar 2026)
fare_evidence.fare_local: R$48.00 per car (R$10 motorcycles – R$140 buses), one-off per entry
fare_evidence.basis: Municipal demand-management charge on vehicles entering the island — raises the effective cost of car-based access and favours passenger-first water mobility.

regulator: Semil-SP (Secretaria de Meio Ambiente, Infraestrutura e Logística) via Departamento Hidroviário / Coordenadoria de Travessias; from Nov 2025 PPP, concessionaire Acqua Vias SP (led by Internacional Marítima, 20 years, 45 vessels of which 41 electric); Marinha do Brasil (Capitania dos Portos) for vessel/crew certification; Prefeitura de Ilhabela (Secretaria de Mobilidade e Segurança) for the Aquabus and island piers.
annual_basis_note: No official calendar-year passenger series is published per crossing. Best per-crossing anchors: Jan 2024 daily average 12,584 users/day (Semil VDM) and H1 2024 share (15% of 9.65M system trips ⇒ ~1.45M implied H1 users; ~2.9–4.0M/yr plausible range given summer skew — the 12,584/day January figure is peak-season and must not be annualised directly). System-wide: 21.8M (2019), 20.9M forecast (2023). Prior scan's '~22% of state aquaviário volume' could not be confirmed; official H1 2024 figure is 15% of trips (second-busiest after Santos–Guarujá).
gaps: No open per-crossing annual time series (Semil publishes episodic press figures, not a dataset) — FOI/LAI request or concession data room would close this.
Prior scan claim of ~22% share of state aquaviário volume not reproducible; official Jul 2024 figure is 15% of trips. Used the official number.
Aquabus ridership beyond early Dec 2024 (~44k) not yet published.
Pedestrian-only annual count for the crossing not published; only the Jan 2024 daily average (5,752/day) and summer aggregates.
No verifiable premium ride-hail (Uber Black/99) fare table for São Sebastião found from citable sources; Hora Marcada + tour-boat pricing used as the premium comparables.
